subject: 99 Revere Beach Parkway Residential Redevelopment
overview: The Commission approved a Notice of Intent for a large-scale residential redevelopment at 97-99 Revere Beach Parkway with conditions focused on habitat preservation and stormwater control. Members also reviewed meeting minutes and discussed the potential regulatory impacts of the state's proposed Mass Ready Act on local wetland protections.

items.title: 99 Revere Beach Parkway Redevelopment
items.summary: Approved the Notice of Intent for the redevelopment of 97-99 Revere Beach Parkway into a six-story residential complex featuring public greenway access and habitat enhancements along the Malden River. The Commission imposed special conditions requiring porous pavement, the preservation of native black locust and birch groves, and specific herbicide application protocols for managing invasive species.

items.title: Administrative Matters and Minutes
items.summary: Approved previous meeting minutes and discussed the search for a new commission member with an environmental engineering background to fill a current vacancy.

items.title: Mass Ready Act Legislative Discussion
items.summary: Discussed the implications of the proposed Mass Ready Act, with members expressing concerns regarding potential permit exemptions for culverts and climate resiliency projects that could bypass local conservation review.
